subject: Priority wave: Developer webinar — seed, fallback links, reminders
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 12:15:00 +0000
Subject: Priority wave: Developer webinar — seed, fallback links, reminders
Attachments: emea-seed-list.csv (CSV, 14KB); tracking-map-utm.csv (CSV, 2KB)

Team — kicking off the operational plan for the Oct 21 developer webinar (technical deep-dive on inference cost/latency tradeoffs). Goal: high-quality EMEA attendance (engineers/infra) with APAC as secondary wave. Key asks and plan below. Please review and ack by EOD so we can lock subjects and tracking tomorrow.

High-level plan
- Wave 1 (EMEA priority): send Oct 14 09:00 BST (local send window 08:00-11:00)
- Wave 2 (APAC warm list): send Oct 15 11:00 SGT
- Seed lists: attached (EMEA warm + VIP). There is a small partner-sourced VIP subset (CloudCo).

Tracking / links resilience
- Primary tracking domain: links.redwood.ai (HubSpot UTM tokens).
- Failover: if links.redwood.ai 5xx or redirect fails, fallback to rwd.co/emu (short link) mapped in tracking-map-utm.csv. Need final mapping by Monday.
- HubSpot IDs: please confirm the campaign/flow IDs so we can map registrant properties.

Reminders cadence (recommended)
- Confirmation (immediate after register) — handled by product
- Nudge 1: 3 days before (content: what you'll learn + speaker lineups)
- Nudge 2: 24 hours before (calendar add + join link + streaming fallback)
- Last call: 30 minutes prior (short SMS for VIPs if phone present)

Operational asks (action items)
- Marissa: finalize two subject-line variants for A/B (technical vs. outcomes) and sign off the copy.
- Ben: confirm tracking domain failover and shortlink mapping. Will you own the tracking smoke-test?
- Olga: confirm partner (CloudCo) promo slot and the link they will use.

Risks / notes
- We have a hard VIP SLATE (10 orgs) that we want to guarantee seats for — consider a separate RSVP routing to a waitlist if capacity hits threshold.
- Streaming fallback: add an embeddable YouTube stream link as a last-resort; keep join link as primary (Zoom).

Attachments: EMEA seed + tracking map.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Program Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
